description: Production HTTP Driver response capture against a controlled origin in an egress-less internal Docker network; no private-network allow switch or third-party load.
correctness_gates: the production HTTP Driver accepts the isolated public-shaped address without any private-network test bypass
the controlled origin has no external network route and publishes an allowing robots policy
a normal user previews and confirms the exact immutable live_refetch Backfill
every job receives exactly one GET and every successful Attempt writes one response Artifact and BackfillOutput
all response Resource bytes match the configured size and MySQL SHA-256 metadata
each bounded 500-item materialization page emits at most one initial wake per selected Executor and each completed supply batch emits one stable capacity-release wake
every Work still owns one fenced Attempt, Permit, command receipt, result, and response Artifact inside the compact execution envelope
all domain event intents reach the Channel ledger and restart preserves state, replay, presence, and Resource reads
non_claims: the controlled origin does not represent third-party latency, rate limits, CDN behavior, or site availability
this is HTTP JSON response capture and does not measure Browser execution
H0/H1/H2 do not substitute for 20K Listing plus 400K Detail daily completion or long-window SLO
